g.text: Income inequality | What accounts for the Gini decline?

g.text: Shapley decomposition • Brazil 2001–2011: −6.5 Gini points • Mexico 2000–2010: −6.2 Gini points

g.text: Share of each country's observed decline (%)

g.text: Labor income was the largest single contributor in both countries: 45% in Brazil and 68% in Mexico.
